Your holdings: SMCI (-45.9%) and SOXL (-84.28%) are deep in the red and need attention. PLTU (-23.52%) and MU (-71.4%) are also significant losers, amplified by leverage.

Watch: Keep an eye on QCOM's setup. It's showing technical strength and could be a potential bounce candidate if the market stabilizes.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, losing positions and respecting your stops.
plays: Trim SMCI: The loss is substantial. Consider reducing exposure to manage risk.
Trim SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down significantly. Re-evaluate your position and stop loss.
Consider QCOM: Scanner shows a long setup (entry 166.93-166.38, stop 164.94). Watch for confirmation.
